title: USS Nautilus fitted with a side hatch to grab discs

tellings.quote: thing that um that we did is we had like this we created this hatch this side hatch to be able to acquire objects that were uh discs uh unknown unknown objects um in the ocean

plain: Sometime between 1963 and 1966, the submarine USS Nautilus is said to have been fitted with a special side hatch so it could pick up unknown disc-shaped objects in the ocean. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells this second-hand. He repeats what someone told him at the International UFO Congress, a UFO conference. If true, it would mean the Navy was set up to collect unknown craft from under the sea.
